name: smwpatches-separate-special-world-music-v1
title: Separate Special World Music v1.1
description:
Allows you to choose separate tracks per map when the Special World passed flag is set.
The music before the Special World is passed is still set via Lunar Magic. The music for when the Special World is passed is set in the ASM file.

Requested by TheBourgyman.
Requires AddMusicK to work.

v1.1
---
Now you can select when to trigger the effect: when overworld colors change, when Koopa palettes change, when sprite graphics change, or after another, different level is beat.
